nodes.label: IntraView Task
nodes.rationale: Novel task for retrieving information from scientific literature by reading papers section-by-section with reasoning-based ranking and iterative evidence gathering.

nodes.label: IntrAgent System
nodes.rationale: LLM-based agent designed specifically for IntraView task, combining hierarchy preservation, reasoning-based section ranking, and iterative reading with information sufficiency checks.

nodes.label: IntraBench Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Expert-curated benchmark with 315 test instances across five scientific domains (physics, earth science, public health, engineering, material science) for evaluating IntraView approaches.

nodes.label: Hierarchy Preservation
nodes.rationale: Component that reconstructs hierarchical structure of paper sections from flat heading list, enabling reasoning-based ranking to understand parent-child relationships.

nodes.label: Reasoning-Based Section Ranking
nodes.rationale: Uses LLM reasoning to rank paper sections by relevance to research question, replacing similarity-based retrieval with semantic understanding of section purpose.

nodes.label: Iterative Reading Stage
nodes.rationale: Action loop that retrieves ranked sections sequentially, extracts details, and evaluates information sufficiency until enough evidence is gathered to answer the question.

nodes.label: Information Sufficiency Check
nodes.rationale: Prevents premature termination by requiring agent to continue reading until sufficient supporting information is accumulated across sections, enabling reliable cross-section synthesis.

nodes.label: Confidence-Based Reading Styles
nodes.rationale: Three reading modes (conservative, balanced, aggressive) allow users to control operational overhead by adjusting sufficiency thresholds and early termination criteria.

nodes.label: LLM-Grounded Multiple-Choice Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Evaluation protocol where LLM maps free-form answers to multiple-choice options, addressing scientific terminology variations (abbreviations, synonyms) and enabling semantic correctness assessment.

nodes.label: Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (SERS)
nodes.rationale: Physics domain in IntraBench covering optical spectroscopy techniques for molecular detection, representing applied physics and engineering applications.

nodes.label: Remote Sensing and Land Cover Classification
nodes.rationale: Earth science domain in IntraBench covering satellite imagery analysis and land use classification using deep learning and multi-source data integration.

nodes.label: Infectious Disease Modeling
nodes.rationale: Public health domain in IntraBench covering mathematical modeling of disease transmission dynamics using compartmental models (SIR, SEIR).

nodes.label: Human Factors and Fatigue Detection
nodes.rationale: Engineering domain in IntraBench covering human performance measurement, fatigue classification, and ergonomic risk assessment using wearable sensors and machine learning.

nodes.label: Additive Manufacturing and Quality Control
nodes.rationale: Material science domain in IntraBench covering 3D printing processes, defect detection, and in-situ monitoring using machine learning for quality assurance.

nodes.label: Vanilla RAG Baseline
nodes.rationale: Retrieval-augmented generation baseline using embedding-based chunk retrieval with fixed 500-token chunks and cosine similarity ranking.

nodes.label: Contextual RAG Baseline
nodes.rationale: Enhanced RAG variant that augments chunks with LLM-generated contextual descriptions to improve retrieval precision beyond dense embeddings alone.

nodes.label: DRAGIN Baseline
nodes.rationale: Dynamic retrieval-augmented generation baseline that determines when and what to retrieve based on model uncertainty and token-level salience signals.

nodes.label: R²AG Baseline
nodes.rationale: Reranking-augmented RAG baseline that uses a learned reranker to guide evidence selection and improve relevance alignment in generation.

nodes.label: LongRAG Baseline
nodes.rationale: Long-context RAG baseline with hybrid retriever, LLM-augmented information extractor, and CoT-guided filtering for coarse-to-fine semantic recall.

nodes.label: LUMOS Agent Baseline
nodes.rationale: Literature-focused agent with iterative planning, grounding, and execution modules for multi-hop reasoning over scientific documents.

nodes.label: PaperQA2 Agent Baseline
nodes.rationale: Scientific QA agent with reasoning-based contextual summarization and relevance scoring for evidence extraction from research papers.

nodes.label: Agentic-Hybrid-RAG Baseline
nodes.rationale: Hybrid retrieval agent combining graph-based and vector-based retrieval with lightweight knowledge graph for structured reasoning over documents.

nodes.label: SciMaster Agent Baseline
nodes.rationale: Tool-integrated agentic reasoning system with Solver, Critic, Rewriter, and Selector roles for multi-stage inference-time workflow.

nodes.label: Main Experimental Results
nodes.rationale: IntrAgent achieves 70.0-75.9% accuracy across seven LLM backbones, outperforming all baselines by 7.9-21.0 percentage points through targeted evidence selection.

nodes.label: Hierarchy Preservation Ablation
nodes.rationale: Removing hierarchy preservation causes 4.9-6.2% accuracy drop, confirming necessity of structural context for effective section ranking.

nodes.label: Confidence Level Ablation
nodes.rationale: Balanced mode (default) achieves 68.3% accuracy with 5.1 avg iterations; conservative mode performs worst (58.9%) despite reading more sections.

nodes.label: Information Sufficiency Check Ablation
nodes.rationale: Removing sufficiency check and using only top-1 section causes catastrophic 43.2% accuracy drop (75.4% to 32.2%), revealing incomplete retrieval and hallucination issues.

nodes.label: Mapping Model Robustness
nodes.rationale: IntrAgent consistently outperforms RAG across different mapping models (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, DeepSeek-R1), demonstrating robustness to evaluation protocol variations.

nodes.label: Robustness to Noisy Section Headings
nodes.rationale: IntrAgent maintains 84.6% accuracy on physics dataset with corrupted headings (beginner-style, noisy, Shakespearean), showing only 4.6% drop from 89.2% baseline.

nodes.label: Statistical Significance Testing
nodes.rationale: Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirms IntrAgent significantly outperforms all 12 baselines (padj < 10⁻⁶) with median improvements of 10.9-27.3 percentage points.

nodes.label: Paper Length Impact Analysis
nodes.rationale: Mixed-effects regression shows paper length (6-49 pages, mean 15.2) has no significant effect on IntrAgent performance (p=0.463), indicating model-agnostic robustness.

nodes.label: Task-Oriented Question Categories
nodes.rationale: IntraBench questions categorized into four types: study subject & experimental setup, data characteristics & collection, technical approach & details, conclusions & results.

nodes.label: Section Ranking Accuracy
nodes.rationale: Reasoning-based ranking achieves 87.5% top-1 accuracy vs 25.0% for similarity-based RAG on physics dataset, demonstrating superiority of semantic understanding.

nodes.label: IntrAgent: LLM Agent for Content-Grounded Information Retrieval
nodes.author: Fengbo Ma, Zixin Rao, Xiaoting Li, Zhetao Chen, Hongyue Sun, Yiping Zhao, Xianyan Chen, Zhen Xiang

nodes.label: IntraView Task: Information Retrieval from Literature
nodes.rationale: Novel task requiring faithful extraction of information from provided research papers in response to domain-specific queries, with explicit hallucination avoidance.

nodes.label: Section Ranking Stage
nodes.rationale: Structure-aware reasoning to prioritize relevant literature sections through heading parsing, hierarchy preservation, and reasoning-based ranking—contrasts with flat semantic-similarity RAG.

nodes.label: Iterative Reading Stage
nodes.rationale: Sequential section access, detail extraction, and sufficiency checking to accumulate information until query is adequately answered; mitigates hallucination through explicit reasoning.

nodes.label: IntraBench Benchmark
nodes.rationale: 315 test instances from five STEM domains (physics, earth science, public health, engineering, material science) with expert-authored questions paired with literature.

nodes.label: Hierarchy Preservation
nodes.rationale: Constructs section tree representing hierarchical structure of literature to support LLM reasoning and structured text parsing; removes redundant nodes.

nodes.label: Information Sufficiency Check
nodes.rationale: LLM-based reasoning to determine whether gathered details are sufficient to answer query; governs iteration loop and explicitly prevents hallucination through anti-speculation instructions.

edges.rationale: Section ranking is the first stage of IntrAgent designed to address the IntraView task by prioritizing relevant literature sections.
Iterative reading is the second stage of IntrAgent designed to extract and synthesize information grounded in provided content.
Hierarchy preservation constructs the section tree that enables structure-aware reasoning in section ranking.
Sufficiency check governs the action loop of iterative reading by determining whether additional sections need to be accessed.
IntraBench is the benchmark dataset designed to evaluate IntraView approaches with 315 test instances across five STEM domains.

hyperedges.label: IntrAgent Information Retrieval Pipeline
hyperedges.rationale: These four components form the complete IntrAgent pipeline: hierarchy preservation enables section ranking, which feeds into iterative reading, which uses sufficiency checking to control the loop.
